::: {.recipe-meta}
**Serves:** 4\
**Prep time:** 10 minutes\
**Cook time:** 30 minutes

[Soup]{.badge .badge-soup}
:::

*Of course you have to eat it with a grilled cheese!*

## Ingredients

- ½ onion
- 6 tbsp butter
- 1 can diced tomatoes
- 1 can tomato sauce
- ¼ cup chicken broth
- 3 tbsp sugar
- 1 cup half & half
- salt and pepper (to taste)
- 1½ tsp parsley
- 1½ tsp basil

## Instructions

1. Sauté onions in the butter.
2. Process the sauteed onions and diced tomatoes in a food processor.
3. Put back in the pot to mix with tomato sauce and chicken broth.
4. Bring soup to almost a simmer.
5. Add sugar, spices, and half & half.
